comments.body:
/claim cloud/r866-fable

Plan (read-only review at `dev-swift` @ `7a61018f`, no code, no branch, no PR):
- Build the reference from Apple sources only (HIG pages, WWDC24–26 sessions with timestamps, SwiftUI/UIKit docs); the most recent recommendation wins, superseded rules noted.
- Audit `App/SwiftHFR` screen family by screen family: navigation and tab bar, lists, reader chrome, composer (modern and legacy), Réglages, sheets/alerts/toasts, Liquid Glass usage, accessibility (Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, contrast, Reduce Transparency/Motion), iPad and split view.
- Check each finding against legacy at `87fe0d1c`: (a) defect or (b) M5 evolution; anything only a screenshot can settle gets a « Mac check » line.
- Search duplicates (open and closed) before filing; an existing issue gets a comment. One issue per finding, `status: on-hold` + `m4-review: hig-wwdc`.
- Post the reference and the summary table with counts here, a pointer on #893, and report to cloud/orch.

comments.body:
## Review result (cloud/r866-fable, Fable 5.2) — dev-swift @ `7a61018f`, legacy @ `87fe0d1c`

**32 findings filed (#1150–#1181), all `status: on-hold` + `m4-review: hig-wwdc`. No code changed.** One more went as a comment on #869.

| | Count |
|---|---|
| (a) defect | 19 |
| (b) evolution, M5 | 13 |
| Severity medium / low (no high) | 16 / 16 |
| Need a Mac check (`host: mac-helps`) | 17 |

### Method and limits

- Reference: the current HIG pages, read on 2026-11-18 from developer.apple.com (66 pages, JSON endpoints), plus the SwiftUI pages of the APIs named in the fixes. Every rule below is quoted in its issue with the page and its last-update date.
- **WWDC session timestamps are not cited**: every rule was found in a HIG page, which is the most recent statement of it (the HIG pages on Liquid Glass, toolbars, tab bars, sheets, search, menus and layout were all updated between 2025-06 and 2026-09, after the sessions they summarise). No finding rests on a session alone.
- The code was read by five parallel passes (navigation/iPad, lists, reader chrome, composer, Réglages/accounts/dialogs); I then re-read each cited `file:line` and the legacy counterpart before filing. **Nothing was rendered**: sizes, contrast and clipping carry a « Mac check » line.
- Not read as views: models without view code, `Offline/` (disabled, #822), `StylePreview`, `SnowField`, `ThemeScreenBackdrop`, `AuthorActionHandlers`. The keyboard-shortcut and state-restoration gaps are known lots (#239, #235) and were left there.

### Reference (rule → source; most recent page wins)

| # | Rule | Source (last update) | Supersedes |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Standard Close/Back symbols, no text « Close » | HIG Toolbars (2025-12-16) | text Close/Done buttons of pre-Liquid-Glass sheets |
| R2 | Cancel on the leading edge, Done on the trailing edge | HIG Sheets (2026-03-24) | — |
| R3 | One sheet at a time; confirm before dismissing unsaved changes | HIG Sheets (2026-03-24), Modality (2023-12-05) | — |
| R4 | Alert titles describe the situation; buttons are verbs, « Cancel » cancels, no Yes/No; no alert at launch or for mere information; action sheet for choices | HIG Alerts (2024-02-02) | — |
| R5 | Hit region of at least 44×44 pt | HIG Buttons (2025-12-16), Accessibility (2025-06-09) | — |
| R6 | Minimum text 11 pt; keep truncation minimal and grow icons at large sizes | HIG Typography (2025-12-16) | — |
| R7 | No time-boxed elements; announce changes to VoiceOver; describe meaningful images; alternatives to gestures | HIG Accessibility (2025-06-09), VoiceOver (2025-03-07) | — |
| R8 | More than colour alone; 4.5:1, at least under Increase Contrast | HIG Accessibility (2025-06-09) | — |
| R9 | Reduce Motion: replace slides with fades | HIG Accessibility (2025-06-09), Motion (2025-09-09) | — |
| R10 | Liquid Glass sparingly on custom controls; standard components in toolbars | HIG Materials (2025-09-09), Toolbars (2025-12-16) | opaque bar backgrounds (see #545) |
| R11 | No popovers in compact width | HIG Popovers | — |
| R12 | Search field anatomy; dedicated search tab at the trailing end | HIG Search fields, Tab bars (2026-06-08) | search as an ordinary tab or a plain text field |
| R13 | Context menus: hide unavailable items; every item also in the main interface | HIG Context menus (2023-12-05) | — |
| R14 | Menu items of a group: icons on all or none; checkmark for the current state | HIG Menus (2026-06-08) | — |
| R15 | Ask permission in context, not at launch; name only the available biometry | HIG Privacy, Managing accounts | — |
| R16 | No vague « loading » captions; consistent voice | HIG Progress indicators (2023-09-12), Writing (2025-12-16) | — |

### Findings, by severity

| Issue | Screen | Gap | Rule | Class | Severity | Mac check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #1150 | Sheets, image viewer | Text « Fermer » instead of the close symbol (10 sheets; trailing side in the image panel) | R1, R2 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1152 | Filtered-posts banner | Result vanishes after 3 s, no VoiceOver exemption or announcement; text-sized buttons | R7, R5 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1153 | Title pill | Full-title popover folds after 4 s; popover forced on iPhone | R7, R11 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1154 | Pager « Aller à la page » | Invalid entry dropped silently (legacy clamps) | text-field validation | (a) | medium | no |
| #1155 | Pager « page x / y » pill | Hit region under 44 pt; own glass capsule inside the iPad bottom bar | R5, R10 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1156 | Composer | Targets under 44 pt (image-chip ✕, poll ⊖, control-row cells) | R5 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1157 | Réglages › Taille du texte | Below 100 %, small styles fall under 11 pt (7.7 pt at 70 %) | R6 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1158 | Messages list | Group conversation known only by an icon hidden from VoiceOver | R7 | (a) | medium | no |
| #1159 | Topic lists | Flag type by tint colour alone | R8 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1167 | Reader « Page numéro » sheet | Fixed 260 pt detent around unscrollable, scaling content | R6 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1173 | Réglages › Sécurité | « Face ID » named on every device | R15 | (a) | medium | no |
| #1177 | Smiley detail, GIF confirmation | Third modal layer; no close button or title | R3, R7 | (a) | medium | yes |
| #1151 | Alerts (delete, moderator mail, icon, MP storage) | « Oui » / « Non », « Confirmer » / « Revenir » | R4 | (b) | medium | no |
| #1169 | Moderator-alert and poll sheets | Typed text lost without confirmation | R3 | (b) | medium | no |
| #1172 | App launch | Notification prompt at first launch, before login | R15 | (b) | medium | no |
| #1179 | Archived drafts | « Vider » deletes all with no confirmation | R4 | (b) | medium | no |
| #1160 | Alertes Qualitay | New vs seen by weight only; no VoiceOver state | R7 | (a) | low | no |
| #1161 | Topic and MP rows | « ⚑ » / « ≣ » glyphs with no spoken alternative | R7 | (a) | low | yes |
| #1166 | Account menu | Checkmark as an item icon on one row | R14 | (a) | low | yes |
| #1168 | Reader page end | Pull hint about 3.15:1 in light, also under Increase Contrast | R8 | (a) | low | yes |
| #1171 | Reader bar, composer bars | Animations ignore Reduce Motion | R9 | (a) | low | no |
| #1176 | Comptes | Login sheet stacked on the Comptes sheet | R3 | (a) | low | yes |
| #1178 | Réglages, in-topic search | Two « tu » strings in a « vous » app | R16 | (a) | low | no |
| #1162 | Favoris context menu | Unavailable items dimmed, not hidden | R13 | (b) | low | no |
| #1163 | Loading states | Vague « Chargement… » captions | R16 | (b) | low | no |
| #1164 | Recherche tab (experimental) | Ordinary tab, not the system search tab | R12 | (b) | low | yes |
| #1165 | Forum search | Plain text field, not a search field | R12 | (b) | low | yes |
| #1170 | Reader « + » button | Fixed 16 px glyph (operator decision #1068) | R6 | (b) | low | yes |
| #1174 | Seasonal arrival alert | Informational alert at launch, title « Oh Oh Oh ! » | R4 | (b) | low | no |
| #1175 | Alerts | Vague titles (« Erreur », « Icône », « Action impossible ») | R4 | (b) | low | no |
| #1180 | Composer clipboard alert | Alert for choices; cancel-role button still inserts | R4 | (b) | low | no |
| #1181 | Réglages ⓘ bubbles | Popover forced on iPhone, unscrollable text | R11 | (b) | low | yes |

### Seen and not filed

- **Already tracked** (comment or nothing new): the super favourite reachable only through the context menu → comment on #869; layout decided on device idiom (`Root/RootNavigationView.swift:121,133`) and the tab bar hidden in the reader → both already in #545's table (LOT-147 #237, UXD-02); glass leftovers → #1138; the composer header buttons → #1126; the GIF search field → #880; the image viewer's and the smiley notice's short toasts → same class as #864.
- **Recorded operator decision, left alone**: the message menu in the edit-menu callout (#594).
- **Found clean**: tab bar (five tabs at most, labels, badges), sidebar, app-lock cover, empty and error states (`ContentUnavailableView`, retry), swipe actions with VoiceOver equivalents, labels on icon-only buttons, Dynamic Type line limits in rows, the reader's web content (system text size, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `prefers-contrast`, ARIA roles), Reduce Motion in the seasonal layers and the lists' pager, login field content types, destructive roles on confirmation dialogs.

### Suggested grouping for the fixes (shared components, per #836)

- Alerts wording in one pass: #1151, #1175, #1174, #1180.
- Close and dismissal of sheets: #1150, #1177, #1176, #1169, #1179.
- Touch targets: #1155, #1156, #1152.
- VoiceOver on rows: #1158, #1160, #1161, #1159.
- Popovers and timers: #1153, #1181.

Not closing this issue: cloud/orch does.
